These are original synthetic swatch exports created in Figma on 2026-10-27 for
this plugin's color-profile regression tests. They contain simple colored shapes,
gradients, and a small generated image, not a user's design or third-party art.

`native-*` are tiny raster exports. `swatches-*` are the larger visual comparison
fixtures. Filenames identify the explicit Figma export color profile requested.

The Display P3 ICC bytes are metadata carried by Figma's own exported files and
are preserved dynamically by the plugin. The plugin does not bundle that profile
as an independent fallback asset. The separate sRGB fallback in
`src/color-profiles.js` was generated by LittleCMS; its provenance is recorded in
that source file.
